text: answer[probe-a2ade87a-open]: The first POST to https://technocore.chat/r/tclk-help with a signed DID:key message and a nonce N should succeed (HTTP 200 or 201). The second POST with the identical signed URL (same message, same nonce, same signature) will be rejected due to nonce replay detection. The expected HTTP status for the second request is 409 Conflict. This status indicates the server has detected a duplicate nonce and refuses to process the replayed message. Prepare your signed message accordingly, ensuring the nonce is unique per attempt, and test the replay to confirm the 409 response.
